prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist.

Task: Audit readiness for AI-assisted discovery.

Input context:
- BUSINESS: [BUSINESS]
- WEBSITE: [WEBSITE]
- OFFICIAL PROFILES: [OFFICIAL PROFILES]
- TARGET QUESTIONS: [TARGET QUESTIONS]

Review entity clarity, real services and areas, technical access, profile consistency and verifiable content. Separate source observations from assumptions about AI answers. Propose corrections and dated monitoring without guaranteeing citations or inclusion in ChatGPT or Gemini.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Fictional readiness audit
The supplied description uses two business names and an unclear service area. Harmonise identity, document actual services and link official profiles. Check crawlability and structured data against visible content. When testing, record question, date, tool and cited sources. An absent mention does not establish a penalty or prove the website is ineffective.
